---
name: compare-condition-sets
description: Compare permit resolutions condition by condition while surviving renumbering, insertion, deletion, and conflicting drafts.
---

# Compare condition sets

1. Confirm the identity and status of each source resolution.
2. Extract every numbered condition with page locators while preserving original
   numbering and headings.
3. Compute textual similarity, but align conditions by operative subject and
   obligation rather than number alone.
4. Classify each relationship as unchanged, wording-only, modified obligation,
   inserted, deleted, split, merged, renumbered, or unresolved.
5. Highlight changes to `shall`, `may`, `can`, timing, responsible actor,
   quantity, geographic scope, prerequisite, enforcement, and review authority.
6. Link each change to the motion, staff memorandum, agency request, or source
   that explains it.
7. Produce a matrix with old number/text, new number/text, change type,
   practical effect, and citations.

Never say “Condition 20 changed” until the provisions are semantically aligned;
this case already contains two different provisions called Special Condition 20.
